neck_height_mm.status: ASSUMED, no source: the part of the overall height taken to stand in the slot opening between the lips; the rest, 3.4 mm, is the body under the lips

thread_length_mm.status: ASSUMED, no source: thread is counted only in the body under the lips (the neck's thread, if the bought nut has one, is not counted)

tnut.m3_body: ASSUMED the same body as the M5 nut
not_modelled: the threaded hole (the thread is the overlap with the screw)

underside_chamfer_mm.status: ASSUMED, no source: 45 degree chamfers on the two lower long edges, sized so the stand-in clears the slot's 45 degree walls of the section used
